name: Light Fingers at the Festival
consequences: while the city crowds the procession to the temple of sun and moon purses are cut and unlocked houses are entered; the watch works the empty streets and drags suspects to the hearing
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L52 (temple of sun and moon; hub of trade); mechanics.md row 14 (festivals) and row 12 (justice pipeline); D-011 events conventions

name: A Royal Tomb Violated
participants: tomb robbers; the guard of the catacombs; the judge
consequences: hungry men break into the underground catacombs where the kings join the ancestors; news arrives in the City of the Moon (the catacombs lie off-map — the v1 map is the City of the Moon per D-005)
source_ref: INVENTED glue on wb §5; notes L59 (underground catacombs of the kings); mechanics.md row 12 (sealed verdict tablets; pursuit; detention not prisons)

name: Marriages and Alliances
participants: marrying families; the temple; faction watchers
consequences: a wedding is held and hearts are bound in honesty; gifts pass between houses and the factions note which families are now tied
source_ref: INVENTED glue on wb §8.3 (Venus list: the binding of hearts; unions: marriages and alliances); notes L207 (D-000)

name: Refugees from the East
participants: displaced households; the gate watch; hospitable households
consequences: households fleeing the eastern raids beg at the gates; hospitality customs are tested and the quarters grow crowded and hungry
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L15 (migrations into the Empire); L20-21 (the Barbarians); mechanics.md row 13 (customs: hospitality)

name: Barley Held Back
participants: grain hoarders; the harvest poor; the temple stores
consequences: hoarders hold barley off the market while hunger grows; grain climbs against silver and the temple's stores are pressed for relief
source_ref: INVENTED glue on D-011 ratified price model (+50% anchor per drought stage); notes L15;L104 (the drought that is breaking the world)

name: A Sea Caravan from the South
participants: merchant houses; the Great Lighthouse; sailors of the gulf trade
consequences: boats round the lighthouse carrying copper and timber and the goods of the south; the quays fill and news travels in with the cargo
source_ref: Gulf maritime trade (Dilmun; Magan; Meluhha) attested in Ur III and Old Babylonian cuneiform archives

name: Locusts on the Fields
participants: outlying farmsteads; the granaries; field hands
consequences: a swarm strips the outlying fields; field hands smoke and beat the crop edges and the granaries count a thinner year
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L15;L104 (the drought breaking the land); wb §4.1

name: Fever in the Quarters
participants: the crowded river quarters; exorcists; amulet sellers
consequences: fever moves house to house in the poor quarters; the sick send for exorcists and wear amulets — for in this land much of medicine is the driving out of demons
source_ref: INVENTED glue on wb §8.1; notes L196 (much of medicine consisted of exorcisms); L197 (amulets/talismans)

name: The Demoness at the Cradle
participants: infants and their mothers; the exorcist; the amulet-maker
consequences: infants sicken in the nights and mothers cry out against the demoness who preys on the newborn; a flour line is laid at the door and the cradle wears a demon-warding amulet
source_ref: the Lamaštu tradition — demoness preying on infants; warded by amulets and plaques (attested in the cuneiform incantation corpus and the archaeological record)

name: A Comet over the Great Lighthouse
participants: stargazers on the lighthouse; diviners; the frightened crowd
consequences: a hairy star drags its tail across the night sky; diviners read it by aeromancy and the crowd whispers that the world nears another age — one more violent and chaotic than the last
source_ref: INVENTED glue on wb §8.2; notes L203 (aeromancy — cosmological events such as comets; meteormancy); wb §1; notes L23 (the verge of another age)

name: The Moon Devoured
participants: the temple of sun and moon; the diviners; the powerful
consequences: the moon darkens over the city of the moon and the city holds its breath; diviners are mobbed for readings and the powerful ask what the eclipse means for kings
source_ref: lunar-eclipse omens of Enūma Anu Enlil (the Mesopotamian celestial omen corpus)

name: Patriot Agents in the Streets
participants: agents of the rebellious alliance; the imperial garrison; tavern crowds
consequences: agents of the southern alliance speak of liberty from the Empire in the markets and taverns; the garrison listens harder than the crowd and names are remembered
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L15 (the south tears up the empire with patriotism and liberty); L52; wb §4.2;§5

name: Whispers of the Serpent
participants: a stranger in the temple colonnade; the worthy and the curious; the garrison's informers
consequences: a stranger asks riddling questions of the flood and the five first cities and is gone before an answer; informers hunt a hidden order that works in the background of men's affairs
source_ref: INVENTED glue on wb §1-2; notes L23;L25-26 (the flood; the five first cities; a priestly secret order working in the background)

name: Raiders in the Region
participants: eastern raider warbands; outlying villages; the city militia
consequences: warbands out of the eastern mountains burn a village and drive off herds; smoke stands over the region and the militia musters behind the walls
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L15 (foreigners from the east raid and pillage as the drought breaks the world); L20-21; wb §4.3

name: The Southern Levy Musters
participants: the alliance's citizen levy; the Prophet; drill masters
consequences: the rebel alliance calls its levy to the fields outside the walls and the Prophet blesses the spears; traders grumble and the young leave the quays for the drill yard
source_ref: INVENTED glue on notes L19 (unite the city states; push back the invading barbarians); L52; wb §4.2;§5

name: The Harvest Market Surge
participants: market stalls; farmers; the temple stores
consequences: the market fills with the reaping's bounty and prices dip as the carts arrive
source_ref: INVENTED (D-012 authored glue); canon anchor notes L57 (growing and reaping); season ids per D-015
